title: Ticket Closure Logs & Rating Transcripts
summary: Closed support tickets now create a detailed #server-logs report with the closing reason, customer rating, and downloadable conversation transcript.
added: Post each ticket's closure reason, customer, closing staff member, rating status, and complete text transcript to #server-logs.
Update the archived log and transcript attachment when a customer submits their rating after the ticket is closed.
changed: Locate #server-logs by its channel name, or use SERVER_LOG_CHANNEL_ID when the channel ID is provided.
Mark ratings as awaiting customer feedback until the 15-day rating window ends; keep the ticket deletion countdown unchanged.
Retain the legacy transcript archive as a fallback when #server-logs is unavailable.

history.summary: CheckMark acknowledgements for successful customer DMs and cleaner support reply embeds.
Ticket commands and release announcement delivery fixes.
